source.provenance: User-supplied cinematic automotive artwork; media rights separate from code licence.

method.export_method: Lanczos3 enlargement of generated colour/lighting edit
method.qa: Full-frame and 512px actual-export rear wheel/body crop reviewed: no visible scaling seams, coherent wheel and door silhouettes, controlled blue-violet lighting. Style edit reinterprets fine star/ground detail; not exact pixel preservation.
method.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather / style-transfer. Edit this exact completed Roadster artwork into our punchy Tokyo Night colorway. Preserve the square composition and all existing geometry: silver car facing left, both scissor doors raised at exact angles, five-spoke wheels, wing, diffuser, four circular rear nozzles, cabin figure/hand shape, mountains and existing star field/Milky Way placement. Change COLOR AND LIGHTING ONLY. Nearly-black indigo sky #10111b, electric periwinkle blue #7aa2f7 and icy cyan #7dcfff highlights, saturated violet #bb9af7 and controlled pink-violet #f7768e reflections. Existing red taillight and warm cabin light become vivid blue-violet with pale luminous cores and tight bloom. Bright clean silver panels with blue and violet reflected edges; black glass stays dark. Cool violet-blue horizon glow; retain stars without adding constellations or excessive nebula effects. Rich cinematic contrast, premium automotive render finish; avoid noise, coarse metallic texture, halos, extra light strips, new objects, altered proportions, invented text or changed pose. Return the full original square framing at maximum practical native resolution.

detail: AI reconstructed; 8K describes export dimensions, not native generation.
